items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the minimum qualifications for the Confidential Senior Human Resources Officer position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Experience Requirement: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units. Options: I have three (3) years of experience related to the duties of the position, including one year in a lead or supervisory capacity, and a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution with a major in business, human resources/personnel administration, public administration or related field. | I have four (4) years of experience related to the duties of the position, including one year in a lead or supervisory capacity, and a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution. | I have five (5) years of experience related to the duties of the position, including one year in a lead or supervisory capacity, and an associate's degree from an accredited institution with a major in business, human resources/personnel administration, public administration or related field. | I have six (6) years of experience related to the duties of the position, including one year in a lead or supervisory capacity, and an associate's degree from an accredited institution. | I do not meet these minimum qualifications.
EDUCATION: A bachelor's degree from an accredited institution with a major in business, human resources/personnel administration, public administration or related field
a bachelor's degree in any discipline area and one additional year of qualifying experience

an associate's degree from an accredited institution with a major in business, human resources/personnel administration, public administration or related field, and two additional years of qualifying experience

an associate's degree in any discipline and three additional years of qualifying experience. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
EXPERIENCE: Three years of experience related to the duties of the position, including one year in a lead or supervisory capacity.
